description: This Java class defines the OrderSet entity within the OpenMRS system. It models a collection of orders that can be used for decision support, including properties such as operator type, category, and its members. The class provides methods for managing the list of order set members, handling their addition, removal, and retrieval, with support for behaviors like retiring members and respecting list positions.

classes.name: OrderSet
classes.description: Represents a set of orders in OpenMRS, supporting categorization, operators defining how members are combined, and methods for managing the set's members.

methods.name: getOrderSetId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order set.

methods.name: setOrderSetId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order set.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator type (ALL, ONE, or ANY) dictating how members of the set are combined.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the operator type for the order set.

methods.name: getOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of members in the order set, initializing with an empty list if null.

methods.name: setOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Replaces the current list of order set members.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category concept associated with the order set.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the category concept for the order set.

methods.name: addOrderSetMember
methods.description: Adds a new member to the order set at specified position or at the end if position is null.

methods.name: addOrderSetMember
methods.description: Adds a new member to the end of the order set's member list.

methods.name: findListIndexForGivenPosition
methods.description: Determines the correct index in the list for a given position, supporting negative indices and bounds checking.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the order set, compatible with generic entity handling.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the order set.

methods.name: getUnRetiredOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Returns the list of order set members that are currently not retired.

methods.name: removeOrderSetMember
methods.description: Removes a specified member from the order set.

methods.name: retireOrderSetMember
methods.description: Marks a specified member of the order set as retired.
